turnaround_reason: Asset-light LTL/logistics operator wrecked by the debt-heavy 2024 Omni Logistics merger; new management is driving record revenue and margin gains across all segments while deleveraging through targeted divestitures.
bullish_points: Q2 2026 record revenue $673M and best EBITDA in 2.5 years, with margin gains in all three segments (Expedited EBITDA +40% y/y)

Strategic review pivoted from full company sale to targeted divestitures (Intermodal + legacy Omni ~$394M revenue); Intermodal sale on track to close by YE26, $27M of small Omni sales already done — proceeds cut debt
Massive Q2 EPS surprise (reported 1.53 vs -0.15 est); CEO calls it 'best financial position since taking office'
Analyst mean target $28 vs ~$16 price (small coverage, but large implied upside)
bearish_points: Balance sheet still stretched: $2.1B debt, negative book equity (P/B -4.6), forward P/E ~37
Largest customer (~$250M annual revenue) at risk — company expects to retain only 50-75%
Only 2 analysts covering; thin options liquidity
Turnaround depends on executing asset sales into a soft freight market
catalyst: Intermodal divestiture close with proceeds to debt paydown, largest-customer retention decision, and Q3 earnings
catalyst_timing: Intermodal sale by end-2026; Q3 earnings ~Nov 4 2026
suggested_trade: Small-to-medium spot $15-16, add on confirmation of the Intermodal-sale close; wide stop given leverage
key_risk: Balance-sheet leverage plus loss of the major customer's revenue derails the deleveraging path
would_skip_if: Divestiture timeline slips or the largest customer walks entirely
